trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was v2.3.0.
- **Rollback:** I first attempted a rollback to v2.3.0, but the rollback tool was persistently unavailable (503s). Since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production (no change-manager approval required), I used the deploy tool to roll out v2.3.0 to all production regions instead. This succeeded.
- **Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which pages the on-call engineer, with a summary of the failure, the rollback action, and the verified recovery.
